On the facing page (fol. 19b), 'L —' points toward c. 119(4). That arrow follows a note reading 'ff.1-31, adhy. i-viii. Śaka 1807, Saṃv. 1942. I.O. 3599 (which has 29 adhy.)'. The facing note's ff.1-31 matches c. 119(4)'s extent of 31. The 32 leaves of ff. 4-35 match the corrected extent '3[2]' of d. 302 (2). Both notes cite I.O. 3599. This favours d. 302 (2) for b019, but no linking mark is visible on the target page.
After 'd. 1' there is a looped and overwritten form, roughly 'Z' or '2' with a stroke. The wavy cancellation line runs through it. No digit can be read with confidence.
